QuestInfo.name: More Important than a Diamond Ring
QuestInfo.0: The ring was made but from the ore fragments but Allen is still hesitant. Go ask him if anything is wrong.
QuestInfo.1: Allen is still doubting himself and doesn't know if marrying Le Tierre would be the best thing for her. Allen says he will leave everything up to Le Tierre's answer.
QuestInfo.2: Allen finally runs to Le Tierre after she tells him that she will not forgive him if he does not propose to her.

0.0: This ring isn't a diamond, but it looks doggone good to me! But... will I be able to make Le Tierre happy down the road?
0.1: Maybe she's tired of me. Maybe she's falling for J. He's so ruggedly handsome and exciting. Will you find out what she's thinking?

yes.0: I'll set her free, if that's what she wants. Please, give her this ring and tell her I'm okay with whatever decision she makes.

no.0: How can I propose? It's like dooming her to a life of poverty...

1.0: Le Tierre still wants me?! \r\n#L0##bUh, yeeeah! Go propose to her RIGHT NOW!#l\n#k
1.1: But I've been so busy in the lab that I haven't showered in a week. Should I clean myself up first? No, I can't make Le Tierre wait a single moment longer!

default.0: I'm okay with whatever decision she makes.
